name: list_documents
description: List records of a doctype (e.g. SalesInvoice, Party, Item, Payment, AccountingLedgerEntry). Optional filters + fields.

name: get_document
description: Get one record by doctype + name.

name: get_outstanding
description: Total outstanding for receivables (schemaName=SalesInvoice) or payables (PurchaseInvoice) in a date range (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: get_cashflow
description: Cashflow report for a date range (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: get_income_and_expenses
description: Income and expense totals for a date range (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: create_party
description: Create a customer/supplier. role: Customer | Supplier | Both.

name: create_item
description: Create an item. rate is a currency amount in major units (e.g. 100 or 100.5). for: Sales | Purchases | Both.

name: create_account
description: Create a chart-of-accounts account. rootType: Asset|Liability|Equity|Income|Expense.

name: create_sales_invoice
description: Create a DRAFT sales invoice (money). account = the receivable (e.g. Debtors); item account auto-resolves. rate per line is a currency amount in major units (e.g. 100 or 100.5). Submitting it later posts the ledger. Requires human approval.

name: create_payment
description: Create a DRAFT payment (money). paymentType: Receive | Pay. amount is a currency amount in major units (e.g. 100 or 100.5). Requires human approval.

name: submit_document
description: Submit a document (SalesInvoice/PurchaseInvoice/Payment/JournalEntry) — this POSTS double-entry ledger entries and moves money on the books. Requires human approval.

name: cancel_document
description: Cancel a submitted document — reverses its ledger entries. Requires human approval.

name: delete_document
description: Delete a document. Requires human approval.
